title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of One Hundred thousand Pesos for the Alteration and Improvement of the Bureau of Public Works storehouse on the Port Area, Manila, to Make It Suitable for Insular Government Offices.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated from the balance or funds remaining to the credit of the "Irrigation
and Permanent Public Works Bond Issue" fund, created by section seven of Act Numbered Thirty hundred
and thirteen, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos for the construction of concrete floors and other
permanent improvements in the Bureau of Public Works storehouse on the Port Area, Manila, to make it
suitable for offices of the Insular Government, the provisions of Act Numbered Thirty hundred and eleven to
the contrary notwithstanding.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 5, 1932.
